contractFactsImplemented: Managed tool ids are closed to openspec and archify.
Managed runtime resolution uses repository-tracked identity plus explicit FLOWKIT_HOME and never falls back to PATH/global installations.
Configured runtime roots and entrypoints are fail-closed and confined to the expected managed location.
Exact runtime package name/version and entrypoint file presence are validated before success.
Resolution is on demand for only the requested managed tool; a missing peer does not block it.
Successful resolution returns immutable tool id/version/runtime-root/entrypoint facts and never invokes the tool.
Failure behavior uses the approved closed deterministic diagnostic catalog.
toolchain.lock no longer carries Node/pnpm exact resolver authority; Node host compatibility remains package.json#engines.node and pnpm identity remains package.json#packageManager.
Node 22.23.2 remains only a reproducibility fixture and is not enforced by managed-tool resolution.
Artifact hashes remain provenance metadata and are not required as live runtime attestation.
limitations: Independent review-apply has not yet been performed.
